id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

state.description:
The current state of the execution of the build.
Changes as the build and its steps progress through Jarvis.

stateHistory.description:
The history of state transition. The most recent state is at the last index and
will have the same value as {@link #state}.
This is managed by the system and should never be set directly.

expiresAt.description:
The date at which the data related to this build expires.
Applies to artifacts for this build, unless {@link #keepForever} is true.

keepForever.description: Whether to keep this build forever.

repositoryUrl.description: The repository the branch belongs to

branchUrl.description: The source control service URL for {@link #branch}.

sha.description: The head of the {@link #branch} that was built

shaUrl.description: The source control service URL for the {@link #sha}.

prUrl.description: The source control service URL for the corresponding PR on this branch, if present.

packagesPath.description: The path in source control which leads to the packages which should be processed by this build.

preReleaseTag.description:
A tag to be used at the beginning of the {@link SemanticVersion#preReleaseVersion} for artifacts generated
during builds for this branch group.

firstStepName.description:
The name of the first {@link Jarvis.Lambda} that should be executed.
The default step is 'generatePackageSteps', which is run after 'stashRepo'

changes.description:
Commit diff of this build
TODO: diff needs to be strongly typed

buildNumber.description: The build number for this build. Unique by {@link #branch}.

title: Represents a single Jarvis Pipeline run
name: Jarvis.Build
